patch.summary: Constant Contact cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: Constant Contact pricing is plan-gated across 3 researched tiers. No free plan confirmed in SoftwareGlimpse research. 14-day trial documented. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.
